title: Customer Support Executive @remote
description:
Hello Job Seekers, 
 Note: ShiningStars ITPL does not charge any amount in exchange of any job opportunities, our services absolutely free of cost. Please beaware of fraudsters! 
 We are actively hiring for Domestic / Customer Support Processes for Work from Home. 
 Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply as per the eligibility criteria mentioned below. 
 Windows Laptop with minimum i3, i5 and above processor are mandatory 
 Eligibility Criteria: Freshers and experienced candidates can apply. Undergraduates and graduates are eligible. Good communication skills are required. i3, i5 and above processor is required Windows Laptop is necessary with minimum 8gb ram and good wifi speed 
 Salary Package: Freshers: upto 18 K CTC Experienced: upto 19 K CTC 3,000 Quarterly bonus will be provided. 
 Work Benefits & Shift Details: 6 days working. 1 rotational week-offs. Rotational shifts. Please note : Recruiter will connect you on call and will ask for the screenshot of your Adhaar Card, which is the mandatory part of the process, in order to refrain from any proxy cases. Kindly co-operate with them. 
 Interested Candidates, Apply Now! 
 Thanks & Regards,
HR Executive
